name: DiscoveryBench
why_it_matters: Mirrors the core data journalism workflow of surfacing a defensible finding from a messy real-world dataset.
task_shape: Given a natural language research goal and one or more CSV datasets, the model must autonomously explore the data and produce a structured hypothesis that matches a gold discovery.
signals: Covers 264 real tasks across sociology, biology, economics and other domains with gold-standard hypotheses for evaluation.
Top agents score only around 25% on hypothesis discovery, and the fixed hypothesis format may not capture the narrative judgement a reporter would apply.
